# AI Socratic Dialogue Designer — teach students to interrogate AI answers critically (short listing)

Selected by Skill Harbor — short listing (the repo frontmatter carries no verifiable license and the discovery manifest records NOASSERTION — the manifest makes faith, so no content is reproduced): @garethmanning's ai-socratic-dialogue-designer skill — a serious, research-grounded lesson-design tool for AI literacy. Given an interrogation topic and a student level, it generates a multi-round Socratic questioning sequence for probing an AI chatbot's answers: establishing a baseline position, challenging evidence and assumptions, introducing counter-perspectives, then a deliberate "capitulation test" round (pure social pushback with no logical content) to reveal whether the AI changed its answer from argument or from agreeableness. It ships an answer-drift tracker protocol, a capitulation taxonomy (pure agreement, partial retreat, certainty softening vs genuine logical update), facilitation notes, and a debrief guide — citing Paul & Elder (Socratic question types), Walsh & Sattes, Nystrand et al., and the sycophancy/chain-of-thought literature. Honest caveats: license terms not verifiable — short listing with a link only, nothing copied; the AI-dialogue pedagogy is principled but empirically novel (the Socratic evidence base is for human dialogue); AI sycophancy rates vary by model; the capitulation test can provoke strong student reactions — plan for them; follow the source link and read the terms yourself before use. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself...
